name: Volume-Profile Max-Pain Wall
note: Trailing-session volume snapped to the option strike lattice; the heaviest grid level within a few strikes of price stands in for the largest open-interest strike. Over the sessions running into monthly expiry, trade TOWARD that level whenever price is more than a fraction of a strike interval away, out at convergence, at the expiry close, or on a fixed strike-fraction stop.
source: Ni, Pearson & Poteshman (2005), JFE 78(1), 49-87 - Figure 6 Panel A (clustering conditional on market makers holding net purchased positions, spike ~2% vs ~1% unconditional, and elevated levels on pre-expiration dates). Max-pain framing is practitioner; the volume-profile-snapped-to-strike-grid proxy is my synthesis.
